name: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality
source_citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029
mission: To protect and enhance North Carolina's environment and natural resources, and preserve them for the health, well-being and economic benefit of present and future generations.
eligible_applicant_types: Public and State controlled institutions of higher education

goals.title: Environmental and public health protection
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 4
goals.description: Protect public health by setting and implementing science-based standards and by providing technical, compliance, permitting and financial assistance to residents, communities, businesses, and local governments.
objectives: Protect public health by setting and implementing science-based standards and by providing technical, compliance, permitting and financial assistance to residents, communities, businesses, and local governments.

goals.title: Community restoration and resilience
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 6
goals.description: Support and accelerate the long-term recovery of communities devastated by Hurricane Helene and other natural disasters, and lead efforts to make communities more resilient.
objectives: Support and accelerate the long-term recovery of communities devastated by Hurricane Helene and other natural disasters, and lead efforts to make communities more resilient.

goals.title: Forever chemicals (PFAS)
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 8
goals.description: Protect North Carolina's people and natural resources from exposure to PFAS and other forever chemicals, using a transparent, collaborative, and science-based decision-making process.
objectives: Protect North Carolina's people and natural resources from exposure to PFAS and other forever chemicals, using a transparent, collaborative, and science-based decision-making process.

goals.title: Environmental infrastructure
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 10
goals.description: Strengthen North Carolina's infrastructure through thoughtful and strategic investments.
objectives: Strengthen North Carolina's infrastructure through thoughtful and strategic investments.

goals.title: Community engagement and public participation
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 11
goals.description: Ensure the meaningful involvement and fair treatment of all people with respect to the development, implementation, and enforcement of environmental laws, health safeguards, and policies.
objectives: Ensure the meaningful involvement and fair treatment of all people with respect to the development, implementation, and enforcement of environmental laws, health safeguards, and policies.

goals.title: Modernize DEQ
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 12
goals.description: Modernize processes and foster innovation to enhance efficiency in services, increase transparency, and strengthen partnerships.
objectives: Modernize processes and foster innovation to enhance efficiency in services, increase transparency, and strengthen partnerships.

goals.title: Work environment
goals.citation: NC Department of Environmental Quality Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 13
goals.description: Create a work environment where employees feel valued and are empowered to be active participants in developing science-based solutions.
objectives: Create a work environment where employees feel valued and are empowered to be active participants in developing science-based solutions.
